detector.description: Alerts when number of ready and scheduled DaemonSets have diverged
detector.name: K8S Cluster DaemonSet ready vs scheduled
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.daemonset.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.daemonset.name']).publish(label='B')
C = (A-B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
detect(when((C > threshold(0)) or (C < threshold(0)), lasting='5m', at_least=0.95), auto_resolve_after='5h').publish('K8S Cluster DaemonSet ready vs scheduled')

rules.description: The value of Ready-Scheduled is outside of 0 and 0 for 95% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: K8S Cluster DaemonSet ready vs scheduled
